input.query: SELECT Timestamp, SeverityText, Body, ServiceName, TraceId, SpanId, LogAttributes FROM otel_logs WHERE $__timeFilter(Timestamp) AND ServiceName = 'checkout' AND Body ILIKE '%payment%' ORDER BY Timestamp DESC LIMIT 1000
input.explanation: Returns checkout service logs from the time range whose Body contains "payment" case-insensitively, newest first.
